newsitem.title: USA: Green Oasis says to acquire Approved Oil.
newsitem.headline: Green Oasis says to acquire Approved Oil.

text.p: Green Oasis Environmental Inc said Monday it entered a definitive agreement to acquire the assets of Approved Oil Services Inc for an undisclosed amount.
The company said Approved Oil is privately held.

The company said it plans to establish Approved Oil's facility as its second regional waste oil processing facility and purchase waste oil from the area's smaller collectors for processing into diesel fuel with its enviroeconomics system.
The company said Approved Oil collects in excess of four million gallons of waste oil annually.
Green Oasis said this is the first of several planned acquisitions.
